mapper.select: SELECT h.*, d.id as dorm_id, d.building as dorm_building, d.room_number as dorm_room_number FROM health_check h LEFT JOIN dormitory d ON h.dormitory_id = d.id ORDER BY h.check_date DESC, h.create_time DESC
SELECT h.*, d.id as dorm_id, d.building as dorm_building, d.room_number as dorm_room_number FROM health_check h LEFT JOIN dormitory d ON h.dormitory_id = d.id WHERE h.id = #{id}

SELECT h.*, d.id as dorm_id, d.building as dorm_building, d.room_number as dorm_room_number FROM health_check h LEFT JOIN dormitory d ON h.dormitory_id = d.id WHERE h.dormitory_id = #{dormitoryId} ORDER BY h.check_date DESC

SELECT h.*, d.id as dorm_id, d.building as dorm_building, d.room_number as dorm_room_number FROM health_check h LEFT JOIN dormitory d ON h.dormitory_id = d.id WHERE h.check_date = #{checkDate} ORDER BY h.create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO health_check(dormitory_id, check_date, score, grade, comment, checker_id, checker_name, create_time, update_time) VALUES(#{dormitoryId}, #{checkDate}, #{score}, #{grade}, #{comment}, #{checkerId}, #{checkerName}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE health_check SET dormitory_id = #{dormitoryId}, check_date = #{checkDate}, score = #{score}, grade = #{grade}, comment = #{comment}, checker_id = #{checkerId}, checker_name = #{checkerName}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
